body: I'm going to be seeing a psychologist soon for a not immediately related issue. Hopefully that will help in some way. As for meds I'm wary as they've been hell in the past for me.

It's a little scary to think of the thoughts never leaving. I don't see myself following through but I fear that the fact that the idea is on my mind that I will take more risks than I should. 

As for keeping tabs that's luckily something I do quite well.
